beside_run_3_on_the_same_tables.reading: What is reported beyond the measured range changes from run to run: 13 tables were reported in both runs, 5 only in the third and 2 only in the fourth. The third run's two inaccurate reports were, in the fourth, one held back as tentative and one replaced by an accurate law. Neither run alone, nor the two together, bounds the share of wrong reports there: 2 of 10 and 0 of 8 on the same tables.
beside_run_3_on_the_same_tables.what: runs 3 and 4 read the same 120 tables with the same seeds; the searches are limited by time, so they need not find the same laws

reading: Inside the measured range (three inputs, noise up to 5 %): 7 laws reported in 20 readings, none inaccurate.
Beyond it: 8 laws reported in 100 readings, none inaccurate (three inputs at 10 % noise 1; four inputs 6; five inputs 1). At 20 % noise nothing was reported at any number of inputs.

No reported law is the law itself by the benchmark's test of form, inside the range or beyond it: these invented laws are harder than the benchmark's, and what is reported is an accurate description, not the law.
93 of the 100 readings beyond the range were marked by the reading itself as outside its measured range; the others as unknown, or ended in an error.
One reading ended in an error (a least-squares fit that did not converge) and reported nothing; three did in run 3. That is a defect of the reading, separate from the stopping.
Too few reports to bound the share of wrong ones ('not shown' under the rule named on 25 November), and see the comparison with run 3: the same tables gave 2 inaccurate reports of 10 there.

run.the_bound_on_the_wait: a search process still there 20 s after the portfolio began waiting for it (seen in the waiting thread's stack) is killed; fallback 60 s after the searches' deadline

what: development: the product's table reading, with the search stage in force and search processes that cannot stop a run, on invented laws beyond the conditions it was measured in (three inputs, noise up to 5 %). Not a result: nothing was fixed beforehand and one run is one draw

whether_it_stopped.reading: In every one of the 80 readings with four or five inputs one search process was sent the stop signal while alive; none with three inputs. 19 of the 80 never went and were killed by the watcher, each 20 s after its signal. Without the watcher each of the 19 would have stopped its shard for ever, as in run 2. No stall report, no process left over. This is the run the owner's decision of 2026-11-25 waited for.
